title: Why Do Conventional World Models Fail to Learn Cellular Automata?
abstract: arXiv:2609.39604v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Although conventional world models - auto-regressive or diffusion models based on transformers or convolutional networks - may learn surface statistics of world dynamics, can they learn the exact world dynamics from its observed history? Leveraging cellular automata as a simple testbed, we find the answer to be no in many cases. Conventional architectures predict most pixels correctly yet rarely complete a rollout: a CNN predicts 96.3% of cells but completes 18.9% of rollouts; a joint diffusion model completes none. We trace the gap to three failure modes of these world models - namely, they fail to exactly capture spatial locality, temporal locality or temporal stability. Simple changes repair each: (1) for spatial locality, two-dimensional rotary positions lift a transformer from 39.1% to 100% on the Game of Life; (2) for temporal locality, handing each token its cell's previous-frame neighbourhood lifts the same transformer from 25.8%

translated_title: 为什么传统世界模型无法学习元胞自动机？
translated_abstract: 尽管传统世界模型——基于Transformer或卷积网络的自回归模型或扩散模型——可能学习到世界动力学的表面统计特征，但它们能否从观测历史中学习到精确的世界动力学？我们利用元胞自动机作为简单的测试平台，发现在许多情况下答案是否定的。传统架构能够正确预测大部分像素，却很少能完成完整的推演：一个CNN能预测96.3%的细胞，但只能完成18.9%的推演；一个联合扩散模型则一个推演都无法完成。我们将这一差距归因于这些世界模型的三种失败模式——即它们无法精确捕捉空间局部性、时间局部性或时间稳定性。简单的修改即可修复每一种问题：（1）对于空间局部性，二维旋转位置编码将Transformer在生命游戏上的表现从39.1%提升到100%；（2）对于时间局部性，为每个token提供其对应细胞上一帧的邻域信息，将同一Transformer从25.8%……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文发现传统世界模型（CNN、Transformer、扩散模型）因无法精确捕捉空间局部性、时间局部性和时间稳定性这三种失败模式而难以完整推演元胞自动机的精确动力学，并通过二维旋转位置编码、上一帧邻域token等简单架构修改逐一修复了这些问题。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies three failure modes—spatial locality, temporal locality, and temporal stability—that prevent conventional world models from exactly learning cellular automata dynamics, and shows each can be repaired with simple changes such as 2D rotary position embeddings and previous-frame neighborhood tokens.
